input.free_text_description: The system operates in the messaging, authentication domain. It serves System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include authentication, chat, chat room. Core business data revolves around InstantMessageBuilder, NewUserValidator, Role, User.

user_stories.story: As a System, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a System, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
As a System, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a System, I want to manage authentication operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a System, I want to manage chat operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
